claims.summary: Accusative singular inanimate o-declension nouns match nominative.
The attested direct-object example Он передал яйцо retains the nominative-shaped inanimate o-declension form.
Cornell’s grammar directly supplies Он передал яйцо and labels яйцо nominative-identical.
The cited rule is specific to inanimate singular o-declension nouns.
